nodes.author: kulwarnsingh
nodes.text:
Symptoms - mild

1.Cold.    2. Cough.  3.Sore throat 
4. Mild Fever.

Severity symptoms 

1. Breathing difficulties 2.Respiratory distress.
3. Uncontrolled fever.
#IMA #Ayush #ICMR https://t.co/MkHqY9mVhR

nodes.author: kulwarnsingh
nodes.text:
Vulnerable groups.

1.Children below 5-6 years.

2.Elderly above 65.

3.Comorbidities like Asthma
    COPD,Medications,CAD.

4. Weakened immune response as in AIDS, TB. https://t.co/0wYnQ6Enuf

nodes.author: kulwarnsingh
nodes.text:
Incubation period 

3-6 days.

Precautions

As we already have experience from COVID-19, like Face mask, Hand hygiene, Social distance, isolation and above all keeping strong immune system.with Life style,diet and medicine. https://t.co/cHmgWnAb7m

nodes.author: kulwarnsingh
nodes.text:
Treatment 

As there is no vaccine available for HMPV treatment consists of treating symptoms of cold, fever, body ache with antiallergics , Anti fever & and pain killers. https://t.co/OkS2p0jVi0

nodes.author: kulwarnsingh
nodes.text:
As we are approaching towards spring season there are increased chances to get infected so follow advices as below 
1. Maintain Proper Hydration
2. Eat Healthy, hygienic &       
      nutritious diet,
3. Avoid smoking.
4. Maintain active Life style.
